prompt: At a college, $60$ percent of students own a tablet, $50$ percent own a gaming console, and $30$ percent own both. What is the probability that a randomly chosen student owns a tablet OR a console?
hint: These events overlap (some students own both), so you cannot just add.

hints.text: These events overlap (some students own both), so you cannot just add.
General addition rule: $P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B)$. The subtraction removes the double-counted overlap.

explanation: Adding $0.6 + 0.5 = 1.1$ counts the $30$ percent who own both devices twice, which is why it exceeds $1$.
$P(\text{tablet or console}) = 0.8$, so $80$ percent own at least one.
